steps.name: Check symbol binding, compare every case exactly and replay the controls
steps.run:
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/policy-native"
oracle="$out/oracle-build/kicad-oracle"
adapter="$out/oracle-build/CMakeFiles/kicad-oracle.dir/shims/kiplatform_policy.cpp.o"
nm -C "$oracle" | grep -F 'KIPLATFORM::POLICY::' > "$out/symbols.txt"
objdump -dr -C "$adapter" | grep -F 'R_X86_64_PLT32' > "$out/adapter-calls.txt"
for symbol in 'KIPLATFORM::POLICY::GetPolicyBool(wxString const&)' \
              'KIPLATFORM::POLICY::GetPolicyEnumUInt(wxString const&)'; do
  grep -F " T $symbol" "$out/symbols.txt" > /dev/null || { echo "missing $symbol"; exit 1; }
  grep -F "$symbol" "$out/adapter-calls.txt" > /dev/null || { echo "adapter does not call $symbol"; exit 1; }
done
grep -F '/oracle-src/reference/libs/kiplatform/os/unix/policy.cpp' \
  "$out/oracle-build/compile_commands.json" > /dev/null
python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("wx", json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["wx_version"])' \
  "$out/oracle-build/oracle-provenance.json"
rust/target/debug/kicad-difftest compare --partial --unit "$UNIT" --root "$PWD" \
  --oracle "$oracle" --rust "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-kiplatform-shim" \
  --report "$out/compare.json"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print({k: r[k] for k in ("status","cases","compared","deferred","failures","unprocessed")}); sys.exit(r["compared"] != 36 or bool(r["deferred"]) or bool(r["failures"]))' "$out/compare.json"
python3 port/oracle/test_kiplatform_policy_inputs.py "$oracle" "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-kiplatform-shim"
"$oracle" < "port/cases/$UNIT.jsonl" > "$out/native.jsonl"

steps.name: Replay the complete corpus in import-free WebAssembly against the C++ replies
steps.run:
export KICAD_KIPLATFORM_WASM_REFERENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/policy-native/native.jsonl"
cargo build --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p kicad-kiplatform-shim \
  --example corpus_parity --features live-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release -j2
node rust/kicad-kiplatform-shim/wasm-test.mjs rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/examples/corpus_parity.wasm

steps.name: Compare every public case exactly and replay the controls on both sides
steps.run:
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/sysinfo-native"
oracle="$out/oracle-build/kicad-oracle"
# The pinned reference symbols are linked from the audited kiplatform archive.
nm -C "$oracle" > "$out/symbols.txt"
for symbol in 'KIPLATFORM::DRIVERS::Valid3DConnexionDriverVersion()' \
              'KIPLATFORM::SYSINFO::SYSINFO()' 'KIPLATFORM::SYSINFO::~SYSINFO()' \
              'KIPLATFORM::SYSINFO::GetMemoryInfo(' 'KIPLATFORM::SYSINFO::GetCPUInfo(' \
              'KIPLATFORM::SYSINFO::GetGPUInfo('; do
  grep -F -- "$symbol" "$out/symbols.txt" > /dev/null || { echo "missing $symbol"; exit 1; }
done
rust/target/debug/kicad-difftest compare --partial --unit "$UNIT" --root "$PWD" \
  --oracle "$oracle" --rust "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-kiplatform-sysinfo-shim" \
  --report "$out/compare.json"
python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print({k: r[k] for k in ("status","cases","compared","deferred","failures","unprocessed")})' "$out/compare.json"
python3 port/oracle/test_kiplatform_unix_p001_inputs.py "$oracle" "$PWD/rust/target/debug/kicad-kiplatform-sysinfo-shim"
"$oracle" < "port/cases/$UNIT.jsonl" > "$out/native.jsonl"
